feature_name: Preserve Event Actions in Mixin Decorators
description: Ensure that event actions defined via the @rx.event decorator are properly preserved when used with mixin event handlers. Currently, event actions may be lost when decorators are applied to methods in mixin classes, causing the decorated event handlers to lose their intended behavior.
functional_requirements: Preserve all event actions (like prevent_default, stop_propagation, etc.) when the @rx.event decorator is applied to methods in mixin classes
Ensure that decorated event handlers in mixins maintain the same behavior as non-mixin decorated handlers
Update the event handling system to correctly merge decorator metadata from mixin inheritance chains
Add validation to confirm event actions are preserved through the decorator chain in mixin scenarios
